definitions.explanation: To cause food or liquid to pass from the mouth through the throat to the stomach.
To comprehend or internalize information or a situation.
To refrain from expressing words or emotions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{込|こ}む⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took time to grasp the situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I swallowed my words (held back what I was going to say).

examples.japanese: ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{噛|か}んで→噛む：01205_kamu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{飲|の}み{込|こ}んで⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{唾|つば}→唾：09110_tsuba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{込|こ}んだ。
⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{飲|の}み{込|こ}めた。

examples.english: I swallowed my dissatisfaction and complied.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{込|こ}む (to swallow X).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates completed action or state. {飲|の}み{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'has swallowed/understands.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{込|こ}む (to swallow food)
- ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{込|こ}む (to grasp the situation)
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{込|こ}む (to hold back tears)
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{込|こ}む (to swallow one's words)

MULTIPLE MEANINGS:
1. Physical swallowing
2. Mental comprehension
3. Emotional suppression

COMPOUND VERB: ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to go into, intensifier)
